_comment: Curated per-product duration-of-EFFECT envelopes for extended-release stimulant formulations, so a logged brand (Concerta, Adderall XR…) draws a curve of the right LENGTH instead of the base immediate-release curve or nothing at all. The release-form code (XR) is an umbrella — Concerta (~12 h), Ritalin LA (~8 h) and Adderall XR (~11 h) are all 'XR' but last very differently — so duration cannot key on the release code; it keys on the specific PRODUCT NAME, exactly like product-strengths.json. Only EXTENDED/special forms belong here: immediate-release products already draw their parent's base curve, and a prodrug (Vyvanse) draws its parent substance's own duration (edit the parent JSON, not this file). Phases are in MINUTES (onset/comeup/peak/offset/afterglow/total), each {min,max}. These are duration-of-ACTION envelopes from FDA labels (Clinical Studies efficacy hours) or clinical convention where the label states no hour-count — NOT the plasma PK trace (for stimulants effect is dissociated from plasma; see Specs/evidence/pharmacology/adhd-formulation-kinetics.md). A single-hump envelope of the labeled length answers the user's 'how long does it work' honestly; it does not claim to reproduce the OROS-ascending or bimodal-bead plasma shape. `basis` records whether the total is a label-stated efficacy duration or clinical convention; `source` is the SPL set_id. Deferred: Jornay PM (delayed ~10 h onset — needs an onset offset, not a simple envelope) and Dexedrine Spansule (niche) stay as timestamp markers for now. Consumed by sqlite.py build_product_durations() → the `product_durations` table, read by SubstanceStore.productDuration(forProduct:). Every `product` ties to its parent for the coverage gate; a missing parent is reported, not failed.

products.note: OROS osmotic, ascending zero-order; label: effect 'maintained through 12 hours after dosing' (Clinical Studies 14.2). Envelope, not the ascending plasma shape.
Bimodal beads (½ IR + ½ enteric), two peaks ~4 h apart; once-daily, clinical convention ~8 h. Envelope only.
30% IR / 70% ER beads, bimodal; once-daily, convention ~8 h. Terminal t½ 6.8 h is absorption-limited, not slower clearance.
Dexmethylphenidate (d-isomer) bimodal beads, two peaks ~4 h apart; classroom convention ~10–12 h. Envelope only.
3.1:1 d:l mixed salts, IR + delayed-release beads (~one broad peak, Tmax ~7 h). Clinical Studies show morning+afternoon efficacy (no explicit hour-count); convention ~10–12 h.
3:1 d:l triple-bead (pH-triggered pulses); label PERMP efficacy significant through 16 h post-dose. Multi-phasic; envelope of labeled length.
Dextroamphetamine SR beads; label says 'once-daily'; convention ~8–10 h. Same SPL as IR tablet.
Bimodal beads 50/50 IR+DR, same design as Ritalin LA. EMA SmPC; convention ~8 h. No SPL (European only).
30/70 IR/ER beads, same ratio as Metadate CD. EMA SmPC; convention ~8 h. European only.
Multi-layer beads 40% IR / 60% ER. NDA 206255; convention ~12 h. FDA label not in openFDA; PK from review docs.
Multi-layer beads ~20% IR / ~80% ER. Ascending profile, longest-acting MPH at ~16 h. FDA-approved 2019.
40/60 IR/ER multi-layer beads, bimodal (Tmax ~1.5 h + ~6 h); convention ~10–12 h. Canada only (Purdue Pharma Canada).
~20% IR / ~80% ER ascending, same design as Adhansia XR; ~16 h, longest-acting Canadian MPH. Canada only.
